docs.title: Financial Reports: Statements, Drill-Down, and Export

sections.text: Dynamic financial reports provide interactive, multi-level statements computed directly from posted statutory journal items. Finance teams can compare periods, expand account hierarchies, drill down into source transactions, and export formatted PDF or XLSX workbooks.

* **Permissions**: Opening financial reports requires at least Accounting Read-Only permissions. Reports respect your company and account access rules automatically. * **Posted Entries Only**: Standard statutory statements aggregate **Posted** journal entries in company currency. Draft entries do not affect balances until posted. * **Multi-Company Currency Consistency**: When combining multiple companies in a single dynamic report, select companies that share the same functional currency (or use [Multi-Company Consolidation](/en/next/user/accounting-consolidation.md) for cross-currency groups).

Open **Accounting → More → Reporting** to access the complete statutory and operational reporting suite: | Report | Purpose | | --- | --- | | **Balance Sheet** | Cumulative Assets, Liabilities, and Equity as of a snapshot date | | **Profit and Loss** | Revenues, Cost of Goods Sold, Operating Expenses, and Net Profit over a period | | **General Ledger** | Full debit, credit, and running balance history per account | | **Trial Balance** | Opening, period debit/credit movement, and closing balances across every account | | **Cash Flow Statement** | Operating, Investing, and Financing cash movements reconciled to Bank & Cash balances | | **Partner Ledger** | Detailed receivable and payable ledger grouped by customer and vendor | | **Aged Receivable / Aged Payable** | Open customer and vendor balances bucketed by overdue aging intervals | | **Tax Report** | Net tax base and tax amounts grouped by tax code for statutory filing | | **Executive Summary** | High-level KPIs (cash, profitability, balance sheet ratios) | | **Invoice Analysis / Posted Journal Activity** | Pivot, graph, and list analysis of invoices and posted ledger activity | Use the top filter bar to refine any report: * **Companies**: Choose one or more authorized companies (**Cash Flow Statement** runs one company at a time). * **Period**: Choose presets (*This month*, *Last month*, *This quarter*, *This year*, *Today*) or enter a **Custom** date range. * **Compare**: Add prior-period or same-period-last-year comparison columns to track variances side by side. * **Options**: Toggle **Unfold all lines** to expand every hierarchy level, **Hide lines at zero** to suppress zero-balance accounts, or **Use fiscal-year opening** in General Ledger. ![Balance Sheet expanded with Unfold all lines and Previous period comparison columns.](/en/next/assets/docs/assets/user-manual/accounting/balance-sheet.webp) ![Profit and Loss compares current-period revenues, expenses, and net profit against the previous period.](/en/next/assets/docs/assets/user-manual/accounting/profit-and-loss.webp)

1. **Expand / Collapse**: Click the chevron beside any section or account (or press **Right** / **Left** arrow keys) to unfold subordinate lines. 2. **Load Additional Rows**: In long accounts, click **Show more** to load additional pages; loaded rows stay intact when exporting or returning via breadcrumbs. 3. **Drill Down to Transactions**: Click any numeric amount—or open the row action menu and choose **Records behind**—to jump straight to the exact posted Journal Items backing that figure. 4. **Return Without Losing State**: Click the breadcrumb trail at the top left to return to the report with your active filters, comparisons, and unfolded sections preserved. ![Unfolding an account in General Ledger reveals every posted journal item and allows one-click drill-down.](/en/next/assets/docs/assets/user-manual/accounting/general-ledger.webp) ![Aged Receivable buckets open customer invoices by overdue interval for credit control.](/en/next/assets/docs/assets/user-manual/accounting/aged-receivable.webp)

The **Cash Flow Statement** computes opening cash, operating/investing/financing flows, and closing cash directly from posted postings affecting Bank and Cash accounts: * **Opening & Closing Cash**: Opening cash reflects Bank/Cash balances before the start date; closing cash equals opening cash plus net period cash movements. * **Internal Transfers**: Transfers between two company Bank/Cash accounts net to zero without distorting operating cash flow. * **Unclassified Movements**: If a counterpart line lacks a cash-flow tag or carries conflicting tags, ERPForAll surfaces the amount under **Unclassified cash movements** for review rather than silently dropping it. ![Cash Flow Statement reconciles opening liquidity, activity cash flows, and closing bank and cash balances.](/en/next/assets/docs/assets/user-manual/accounting/cash-flow.webp)

1. Configure your period, comparison columns, and unfolded sections, then click **Refresh** if new entries were just posted. 2. Click **PDF** to download a print-ready statement, **Print** to open the PDF in a new browser tab, or **XLSX** to download a spreadsheet for audit workpapers. 3. Exported files mirror your active screen view, including expanded groups and rows loaded with **Show more**.

* **Zero Rows Still Showing When Folded**: If enabling **Hide lines at zero** leaves folded zero-balance section headers visible, click **Unfold all lines** or re-apply the period filter to refresh the display. * **Screen Row Limit Reached**: Fold wide sections to clear cached pages before expanding another section or exporting. Administrators can adjust report limits under **Settings → Technical → Reporting → Dynamic Reports**. * **Missing Recent Transaction**: Verify that the underlying invoice, bill, or journal entry is **Posted** (not *Draft*) and falls within the selected date range and active company scope.
